title: IELTS Speaking · Đề luyện tập NL-2
source: Đề tự soạn bởi NihongoLife theo định dạng IELTS Speaking (3 phần)

groups.heading: PART 1 · Introduction and interview
groups.instruction: The examiner asks about familiar topics. Answer each question in 2-4 sentences (up to 40 seconds).

items.text: Let's talk about your daily routine. What time do you usually get up on weekdays?
Is your routine at the weekend different? How?
Now let's talk about food. What kind of breakfast do you usually have?
Do you like trying food from other countries? Why or why not?

groups.heading: PART 2 · Long turn
groups.instruction: You have one minute to prepare (you may make notes), then speak for one to two minutes.
groups.stem: Describe a shop or a market you enjoy visiting.

lines.text: and explain why you enjoy visiting it.

items.text: Describe a shop or a market you enjoy visiting.

groups.heading: PART 3 · Discussion
groups.instruction: Discuss more abstract ideas linked to Part 2. Give extended answers with reasons and examples (up to 75 seconds).

items.text: Why do some people prefer small local shops to big supermarkets?
How has online shopping changed the way people buy everyday things?
Do you think shops in the future will still need staff? Why?
